summary: Through ACHIEVE Mentorship I run PATH 101, a half-hour workshop on Tuesday mornings. Each person names something they want, in their own words, and works out the action steps and skills it will take to get there.
audience: Students from middle school through college, and adults who want a plan too. A lot of them are smart and likable, they just don't have a plan yet. Parents are welcome on Tuesday mornings, and some come along and work on a goal of their own.
problem:
Before: every answer is "I don't know." Parents tell me "He has potential, he just doesn't apply himself" or "She doesn't know what she wants." Young adults say "I'm just figuring it out." Most of them have never had anyone sit down with them, help them decide what they want and break it into steps.
After: they have one goal that belongs to them, down on paper in their own words, and a next step they chose themselves.
moments:
Report cards come home and they go quiet.
College and career talk starts, at school or at the kitchen table.
A first semester that didn't go to plan.
A year out of school, or a job that isn't going anywhere.
A parent wants someone besides them that their teen will talk to about what comes next.
offerings:
PATH 101, the introduction workshop from ACHIEVE Mentorship
The PATH frame I teach around: Purpose, Action, Team, Health
One goal in your own words, with the action steps and skills it will take to reach it
Room for parents to work on a goal of their own on Tuesday mornings
Library Talks, a Wednesday morning community conversation on leadership, teamwork, service and responsible citizenship (not fully set up yet)
howItRuns:
Half an hour every Tuesday, 7:00 to 7:30 a.m. Pacific time, on Zoom. People can ask on the free call how many weeks it runs and when they can start.
The free call is 15 minutes with the NowTRANSFORMED team, booked up to three weeks out. A parent joins for anyone under 18. After the call, the family talks it over at home, and if it fits, the next step is a Tuesday morning.
faqs:
Q: When and where does it meet?
A: Tuesdays, 7:00 to 7:30 a.m. Pacific time, on Zoom. Ask on your free call how many weeks it runs and when you can start.

Q: 7 a.m.? My son won't be up that early.
A: Maybe not. Let him sit in on the free call and decide for himself.

Q: She already has a school counselor.
A: Good. This adds to that. Here the goal is hers, in her own words.

Q: How much does it cost?
A: You'll get the price of PATH 101, and what it covers, on your free call.

Q: Who is behind this?
A: ACHIEVE Mentorship is my own. The free call is with the NowTRANSFORMED team. NowTRANSFORMED is a youth leadership development program.
aboutYou:
I was born and raised in Portland, Oregon. I started young, working beside my father in the family business. After high school I spent more than 25 years in corporate retail, in marketing, management, and employee performance and growth.

Along the way I held leadership roles in community groups including Rotary Club, the YMCA and Junior Achievement, served on nonprofit boards and committees, and coached and mentored young people. Today I run ACHIEVE Mentorship.

My desire is to always be engaged in positive growth and the well-being of our youth and families, schools and community.
mustNotSay:
No prices on the page.
Never promise better grades, college admission or a job. PATH 101 works on goals and next steps.
Don't present it as counseling or therapy, or as a replacement for a school counselor.
Don't say how many weeks it runs. That's for the free call.
